findings.finding: Availability, computability, assurance, consumer eligibility and authority are independently represented and no implication between them is introduced.
Computability is per component and profile and replaces global failure propagation with exact dependency-linked propagation.
Versioned required, optional, warning-only, alternative and prohibited dependency edges are explicit and hidden fallback is prohibited.
Not requested, not applicable, not computable, censored and conflicted remain distinct with exact reason-code families.
Location, motion, organisation, interaction and parent-dependent profiles preserve separate dependency and partial-computability behavior.
Consumer eligibility is exact-consumer and per-component, requires computability and authority, and cannot silently exclude evidence.
Staleness remains consumer-specific and linked to raw age evidence while no numeric threshold or active consumer is selected.
Denominator accounting exposes required counts, compatible units, formulas and partition identities without hiding missingness.
Transition rates use comparable pairs and raw counts remain separate from rates.
Overlap remains claim-specific with raw-unit retention and exact cluster evidence; no canonical adjustment is selected.
Comparability fails closed across incompatible unit, scope, release, clock, dependency, consumer, denominator, overlap or censorship policies.
Global QUALITY is non-governing and cannot drive eligibility or denominator inclusion or hide component reasons.
The proposed implementation delta remains inactive, noncanonical, read-only shadow work and preserves all active and downstream authority boundaries.
No external artifact, market data or R2 write is required and rollback is non-destructive.

recommendation_rationale: The candidate faithfully separates usability dimensions, makes dependency propagation and denominator accounting auditable, preserves raw overlap evidence, prevents hidden exclusion and grants only bounded inactive noncanonical shadow implementation authority.
rollback: Close the unmerged gate PR to preserve lawful main. No active system rollback is required because the candidate has no runtime effect.
